name: U.S. Adult Census Income
description: A larger mixed-type census extract for predicting whether income exceeds $50K.

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.attribution: Becker, B. & Kohavi, R. (1996). Adult [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5XW20.

learning_goals: Handle missing categorical values and higher-cardinality one-hot encoding.
Compare balanced metrics on an uneven target.
Audit subgroup performance and proxy variables before interpreting results.
ethical_notes: Contains sensitive demographic attributes including age, race, and sex. Accuracy is not evidence of fairness; never use this teaching model for decisions.
